data.name: Saffron
data.gender_notes: Saffron is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Named after the expensive yellow spice derived from the flower of Crocus sativus, commonly known as saffron. The name Saffron carries the meaning “Yellow Saffron” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Saffron usually hope their child will grow to embody yellow saffron and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Saffron belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Yellow Saffron.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saffron total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: زعفران
in_arabic.meaning: الزعفران هو نبات ذو رائحة عطرة و قيمة عالية
in_arabic.long_meaning: الزعفران يأتي من الكلمة العربية 'زعفران' التي تعني 'الذهب الأصفر'. وهو نبات ثمين يستخدم في الطهي والطب والزينة. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم كرمز للرفاهية والرخاء. يعتبر الزعفران من التوابل النادرة والمكلفة، وله قيمة اقتصادية عالية. كما أنه يستخدم في الطب البديل لعلاج العديد من الأمراض.

in_urdu.name: زعفران
in_urdu.meaning: زعفران ایک قیمتی اور خوشبودار نبات ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: زعفران عربی زبان کے لفظ 'زعفران' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'اصفر سونا'. یہ ایک قیمتی نبات ہے جو کھانا पकانے، دوا اور زیب و زینت کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ قرآن کریم میں اس کا ذکر رفاہیت اور خوشحالی کی علامت کے طور پر کیا گیا ہے۔ زعفران ایک نادر اور مہنگا توابل ہے جس کی اقتصادی قیمت بہت زیادہ ہے۔ یہ دوا کے طور پر بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: केसर
in_hindi.meaning: केसर एक मूल्यवान और सुगंधित पौधा है
in_hindi.long_meaning: केसर का नाम अरबी भाषा के शब्द 'زعفران' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है 'पीला सोना'। यह एक मूल्यवान पौधा है, जो खाना पकाने, दवा और सजावट में उपयोग किया जाता है। कुरआन में इसका उल्लेख सुख और समृद्धि के प्रतीक के रूप में किया गया है। केसर एक दुर्लभ और महंगा मसाला है, जिसकी आर्थिक कीमत बहुत अधिक है। यह पारंपरिक दवा में भी उपयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: زعفران
in_pashto.meaning: زعفران یو قیمتي او خوش بویي نبات دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: زعفران د عربي کلمې 'زعفران' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې 'ژیړ طلا' ده. دا یو قیمتي نبات دی چې په پخلي، درملو او زینت کې کارول کیږي. په قرآن کریم کې د هغې ذکر د رفاهیت او خوشحالي د نښې په توګه شوی دی. زعفران یو نادر او ګران توابل دی چې اقتصادي ارزښت یې ډیر لوړ دی. دا درملو لپاره هم کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Saffron
in_english.meaning: Saffron is a valuable and fragrant plant
in_english.long_meaning: Saffron originates from the Arabic word 'زعفران' (za'faran), meaning 'yellow gold'. This valuable plant is used in cooking, medicine, and decoration. It is mentioned in the Quran as a symbol of prosperity and well-being. Saffron is a rare and expensive spice with high economic value. It has been used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties. Saffron is associated with warmth, happiness, and spiritual growth in Islamic culture.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Saffron" in the Islamic context represents luxury, richness, and exclusivity. It is often associated with the elite and the well-off due to the high value and rarity of the saffron spice. In various Islamic cultures, saffron is used in cooking and in traditional medicine for its aromatic and therapeutic properties. The name can also symbolize the hope and joy that comes with the dawn of a new day, similar to the vibrant yellow hue of the saffron spice.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, saffron represents the purity and divine beauty that lies within every individual. It is a reminder of the sacredness and intrinsic worth of every human being. Saffron is also linked to the idea of spiritual enlightenment and is often used as a symbol of resurrection and the eternal life that awaits us in the hereafter. The saffron color is also associated with the intense love and devotion one has for their Creator and is mentioned in several Hadiths as a metaphor for the infinite love and attachment we should hold for Allah SWT.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Yellow Saffron" symbolizes Named after the expensive yellow spice derived from the flower of Crocus sativus, commonly known as saffron.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Saffron serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of yellow saffron.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Al-Athir records the name of a town in Yemen as Safuran, which is derived from the Arabic word for saffron.
historical_references.context: Ibn Al-Athir was a prominent Islamic historian and writer.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Saffron remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
